race.comment: SNITZEL TYCOON (14) has raced five times and been in the money on each occasion. Started favourite and led for home but was rounded up by the winner last start over 1100m at Tatura. Placed here at this trip on a heavy deck in August. Bursting to win a race. DANCE THE BOOGIE (12) raced handy then let down in good style only to just fail last time out over this distance at Corowa. Cherry ripe at the third run back from a spell and will be tough to hold out again. NO ORDINARY SHOW (13) has not appeared since leading for home but knocking up at the end of 1000m on debut back in April. Should come back bigger and better and this sharp trip looks right up her alley. The interesting runner is debutant ORDINARY STAR (11) who was an effortless trial winner recently. Respect any positive market movements.
